name: mermaid-rs-renderer
notes: 2026-11-15: Triage reason: Assess documented coverage, output fidelity and stability against mermaid-cli. Revisit if upstream parity becomes important.
2026-11-15: Legacy schema value used for a listed-only candidate; this is not evidence of PRD inclusion.

evidence.result: mmdr 0.3.1 wrote source.mmd to SVG twice, byte-identical (SHA-256 fcdb1be5...); 4 nodes, 4 edges, all six labels; PNG 466x189 within 1px of --size; mmdc 12.0.0 gave the same labels and counts; contact sheet inspected. Wall-clock medians ~20-27 ms vs mmdc ~1.5-2.4 s (facts, not gate).
evidence.scope: mmdr 0.3.1 SVG flowchart: 4 nodes, 4 edges, 6 labels matched to mmdc 12.0.0; PNG size within 1px; byte-identical reruns; no browser lib. macOS arm64. Not other diagrams or themes.

summary: Rust CLI and library render Mermaid text to SVG, with optional PNG output via resvg. Its browser-free native path is useful for scripts needing low startup and memory; layout and syntax coverage should be checked against mermaid-cli.
use_when: Render Mermaid text to SVG without launching a browser
Prefer a Rust-native CLI for scripts where browser startup is undesirable
avoid_when: Use mermaid-cli when you need broader Mermaid compatibility and browser-based themes
Use Graphviz when the graph needs layout controls Mermaid does not expose

assessment.rationale: Cargo metadata lists 0.3.1, MIT and CLI/PNG features; README documents SVG/PNG output and notes a native pipeline. Mermaid feature fidelity remains distinct from mermaid-cli.
